referenceTool.independenceNote: LittleCMS is the reference engine here.  If the application later uses LittleCMS too, these converted values are not an independent-engine check; the raw codepoints, profile sha256 values and standard primaries/white points remain the anchors.  A Qt QColorSpace result must be compared to these values under the stated tolerance, not generated from them.

profileRoundTrips.reason: In-gamut sRGB colours are converted to each hand-built profile and back with relative colorimetric intent. ±2 8-bit code values covers TRC table quantization and 8-bit rounding; it is not a claim about out-of-gamut appearance.

unsupportedDataSpaceCheck.expected: rejected: Lab is not an RGB source profile and the sample has no LUT

reproducibility: Every image is written without wall-clock metadata.  The ICC header timestamp is fixed at 2024-01-01T00:00:00 and zlib level 9 is used.  Regeneration is byte-identical with the same Pillow, zlib and LittleCMS versions; the generationDate field is the only run-dependent manifest value.
license: All fixture bytes are generated by this script from public standard primaries, white points and transfer functions.  No third-party ICC profile or image data is copied into the repository.

embeddedProfile.name: CompareStation sRGB (ICC v2 matrix-shaper)
embeddedProfile.transfer: sRGB piecewise curve sampled at 4096 16-bit table entries

fixtures.expectedPurpose: True RGB48 PNG (16 bits per channel) with the sRGB profile embedded; exercises 16-bit source depth and the RGBA64 sidecar path.  The raw file codes are the authoritative reference; display-buffer conversion may quantize.
fixtures.generationMethod: Hand-written PNG (IHDR colour type 2, bit depth 16, filter 0) with a 16-bit big-endian gradient and the hand-built sRGB profile embedded; zlib level 9

tolerance.reason: A 16-bit PNG stores 0..65535 per channel; an 8-bit display buffer takes (or rounds) the high byte, so one code value is allowed.  Assertions about precision must use the raw 16-bit codes, not the display buffer.

referenceValues.note: Pillow decodes this file to 8-bit RGB for display; the committed bytes remain RGB48 and ffprobe reports rgb48be.

fixtures.expectedPurpose: 16-bit grayscale pair whose 8-bit display value is 16 for both files while the 16-bit codes differ by 8; proves a display-only comparison cannot detect the difference and the 16-bit sidecar can.
fixtures.generationMethod: Pillow Image.save(format='PNG') of a uniform 8x8 I;16 image; PNG colour type 0, bit depth 16, no ICC profile

tolerance.reason: 0x1000/257 = 15.94 and 0x1008/257 = 15.97; both truncation and rounding produce exactly 16, so the 8-bit display value is identical

referenceValues.note: The 16-bit raw codes differ by 8 (0x1008 - 0x1000); the RGBA64 sidecar must preserve that difference.
